transcript.speaker: speaker_01
transcript.text: Thanks Elena. What made the Lakeside pilot work?

transcript.speaker: speaker_02
transcript.text: Front-desk staff cut intake time by about a third, and patients stopped filling in the same form twice.

transcript.speaker: speaker_01
transcript.text: And for the other three clinics, who needs to be involved in the decision?

transcript.speaker: speaker_02
transcript.text: Grace Liu, our VP of Finance, approves the budget, but she'll follow my recommendation.

transcript.speaker: speaker_02
transcript.text: Anything that touches patient data also needs a security review by Sam Okafor's team, because intake forms carry PHI.

transcript.speaker: speaker_03
transcript.text: We'll need a BAA in place, and we can share our HIPAA controls summary.

transcript.speaker: speaker_01
transcript.text: I'll send pricing for the four clinics by next Wednesday.

transcript.speaker: speaker_02
transcript.text: Perfect. Open enrollment starts November 2, so that's our real deadline.
